references.context: Topology: subset equal to intersection of an open and closed subset of X
Set theory: pairwise disjoint subsets indexed by I whose union equals X

references.phrase: all of X covered and pieces pairwise disjoint
references.disposition: No finiteness, ordering, or local finiteness of the family is required by this formulation.

review_rationale: Read all requirements for a partition of X: components X_i locally closed in X, pairwise disjoint, and collectively cover all of X. Do not require finiteness or locally finite indexing unless separately specified.
